title: A Rhino Weighs Up to 3,000 Pounds and Charges at 35 MPH

scenes.text: A rhino charges at 35 miles an hour.
That's a black rhino. It weighs up to three thousand pounds.
That's a small car, moving as fast as a city speed limit.
And it can only keep that speed for short distances.
Its eyesight is poor, so it often charges at what it can't see.
Three thousand pounds. Thirty-five miles an hour.

description:
A rhino charges at 35 miles an hour.
A black rhino can weigh up to 3,000 pounds, and it reaches that speed in short bursts.
Would you rather outrun a rhino or a hippo? Comment below.
first_comment: Black rhinos have poor eyesight but a sharp sense of smell and hearing. Would you rather face a rhino or a hippo?
